sections.zh: 远古时期沃陶姆的母星。昔日辉煌尚可见一斑。
sections.en: The ancient homeworld of the Vultaum homeworld. It has seen better days.

descriptions.zh: 此世界曾经是古代尤特族的首都，曾经生生不息的繁华世界如今已经变成阴森恐怖的不毛之地。
descriptions.en: This world, which served as the capital of the ancient Yuht Empire, once supported life. No longer.

descriptions.zh: 哈本尼斯之泽III，或古时候居民简称的“芬-哈本尼斯”，曾经是第一联盟的首都。
descriptions.en: Fen Habbanis III, or simply "Fen Habbanis" as it was known to its ancient inhabitants, was the capital of the First League.

sections.zh: 哈本尼斯之泽III，或古时候居民简称的“芬-哈本尼斯”，曾经是第一联盟的首都。

descriptions.zh: 无论这个世界的生物圈里面生活着什么，现在一切都已经逝去了。
descriptions.en: Whatever biosphere this world may have once supported is long gone.
